title: Completion under negated restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Completing the bitwise complement of $x$ under the restriction assignment obtained by negating every state in $\rho$ gives the coordinatewise negative of the completion of $x$ under $\rho$.
